name: Taisen Gakuen Touhakuden
source:
Guo Jia leaves sister and hometown to join the army and become a warlord. He falls in love with a noble girl from enemy ranks, and story rivaling that of Romeo and Juliet develops on multiple battlefields of the Three Kingdoms period of China history.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-november-2008-shikkoku-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
郭嘉离开姐姐和家乡参军当军阀。他爱上了敌军贵族少女，在中国历史三国时期的多个战场上展开了堪比罗密欧与朱丽叶的故事。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-november-2008-shikkoku-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
